en: Good! I'll be looking forward to it!

The competitors commend each other on a job well done with
a friendly handshake!
Hmm. That girl's good!

And now for the moment you've all been waiting for.
Mittsu-san will now announce the winner of his special
award!

This award goes to the dancer who Mittsu-san believes shone
the brightest of all during this year's summit!
Now, if you would, Mittsu-san!

It brings me great pleasure to announce the winner of my
special award. The winner is...
A dancer from the "idol" category...
Akari Natsukawa!

And there you have it! The special award winner, the star
we're sure to see great things from, is none other than
Akari Natsukawa! Give her a hand, ladies and gentlemen!
Me? I won the special award?
Congratulations, Akari-chan!
I'm really happy for you, Akari.
No way. I can't believe it!
Congratulations, Akari.

Hey, Mittsu-san is waiting for you on stage. Get up there
and take that first step toward your dream!
Tell us, Mittsu-san, what was it about Akari that made you choose her?

Well, let's see. First of all, I really saw a huge amount of
improvement since last time.

Last year, she seemed little more than a machine. She was
very precise, no doubt, but she lacked that certain "spark."

But this year, I could really tell she was really enjoying
herself. It seems she found what she'd been missing.

She must have come across some good friends or strong rivals
somewhere along the way, people who helped her break free from herself.

To be quite honest, I was torn between her and Haruka
Sawamura. But it was clear from watching Akari that she
truly loves dancing with all her heart.

That was one of the biggest reasons I chose her. She made me
feel as though she loves the art of dance more than anyone
else here.

Dancing is hard work, and only a select few ever turn pro.
Frankly, it's a tough industry, and many drop out along the
way because of it.

But I get the feeling Akari will never give up on dance
again. Watching her today, I could see just how determined
she is.

That's what it takes to be a great dancer. That's what it
takes to keep the passion.

Akari has that, and that's why I chose her. Akari, I think
you and I are going to work very well together, provided
you're willing to make the effort, that is.

Let's hear a big round of applause for the winner of
today's special award, Akari Natsukawa! And a round of
applause for Mittsu-san, as well! Thank you all for coming!

What a great battle that was! And the winner is... Akari
Natsukawa!
I won? I beat Haruka?

Congratulations, Akari. Your dancing just now was amazing.
You deserve the win.
Haruka, thank you so much.
Yo, Sawamura.
Oh, Judy-san!

Where've you been? It's already started! And what about
Akari? Is she coming?
I don't know, but I did my best.
Yeah? Well, knowing Akari, I bet she'll be here.
I hope so.

By the way, that over there is Mittsu. He's the judge for
this event.
So that's Mittsu-san?

Yeah. If he likes your stuff, he could open all sorts of
doors for you. You'd have it made.

At the end of the summit, he gives the dancer he likes the
best his special award. It's like an all-access pass into
the world of professional dance.

Wow. So the special award is the thing to go for if you're
hoping to go pro, huh?

That's right. That's why everybody's so bent on impressing
him. Getting his attention's more important than winning.
I've already entered you and Akari.

I chose the "idol" category for you two, seeing as that's
the one that starts last. That should give Akari time to get
here.
That sounds perfect. Thanks for doing that.

No problem. Now all we can do is hope Akari shows up in
time.

Yui-chan! You came! Thank you. What about Akari? Have you
seen her?
No. She isn't answering her phone, either.

Now, then! We've reached the final stages of our Dance
Battle Summit!

In our next category, last year's queen of jazz, Judy, will
be taking the stage!
I'm up. I'll see you later.
Okay. Good luck, Judy-san!

I hope Akari hurries up and gets here! The idol category is
going to start soon.
I hope so too.

A fabulous performance by Judy! Once again, she's proven
herself to be the queen of jazz!
So what did you think of Judy's dancing, Mittsu-san?

A solid performance. Very nice indeed. The one comment I
have, though, is that I don't see much improvement over last
year.

Ah, a little tough love for our winner, is that it? That's
the world-class Mittsu-san we've all come to know!

And now for the very last category of the Dance Battle
Summit!

We'll be topping things off and going out with a bang! It's
time for the idol category!
Oh no! What do we do? It's starting!

Let's get right to it, shall we? Let's introduce our first
competitor!

You know her from the Princess League, folks! The idol of
the next generation, Haruka Sawamura, has graced us with
her presence!
(Come on, Akari!)

And her opponent is... a bright, young star, really someone
to watch⑬Akari Natsukawa!
Uh? Akari-chan?
I'm here!
Akari-chan!
I'm sorry I'm late, Haruka.
That's okay, Akari. I knew you would come. After all...
I love dance more than anyone!

I really want to thank you later for everything you've done
for me.

But first, we dance! And you'd better not go easy on me,
girl! Let's give it everything we've got, and really enjoy
ourselves!
You got it! Let's go, Akari!

All right. I'll be in touch, Akari. If you want to be a pro
someday, this is your big break. I want you to give it your
all, you hear?
Yes, sir! Thank you so much for this chance!

I'm so happy for you, Akari-chan! It's the first step toward
your dream!
Thank you, Yui.
I'm happy for you, too, Akari.
This is all thanks to you, you know.

I didn't do anything. This was all because of your hard
work.

No, it's because of what you said to me. If you hadn't said
it, I wouldn't have been able to give that performance just
now.
What did I say?

You said that even if I don't consider us friends, you still
like me.
That really made me think.

Just like how you can say you like me, even if we're not
friends, I have to be able to say I love dance, even if I
don't ever turn pro.

Whether I ever make it as a pro or not, the more important
thing is to be able to keep my passion for dance. You helped
me realize that.

I was so busy thinking about my dream and winning that,
somewhere along the way, I forgot to simply enjoy dancing.

And that wasn't right. I love dance. Dancing is one of my
favorite things to do. And I want to keep doing it.

I think that's what my dancing was lacking before, that pure
love of dance. That's why I didn't have that spark.

Thank you for helping me see what I was missing, what I
needed to do. I'm sorry I said such horrible things to you.
Would you ever consider becoming friends again?

I'm afraid I'd never consider becoming friends again,
because we already are.
And I hope it always stays that way!
Nice going, you two.

Okay, enough of this. Now that we've made up, let's go eat
some okonomiyaki! What do you say?
Ooh, that sounds great! Doesn't it, Akari-chan?

It sure does! My treat! I want to celebrate winning the
special award!
All right! It pays to have friends who win awards!

Hehehe. It really does. I sure am glad Akari is our friend.
How else are we going to get free okonomiyaki?
Hey, is that the only reason!?

(Having friends sure is wonderful. And I'm lucky to have ones so
great.)
Haruka-chan, what are you doing? Let's go!
Yeah, come on, Haruka!

So you two have been doing dance battles together, huh? I
knew you were into dance, Akari-chan. I bet Haruka-chan's
pretty good, huh?

She's incredible! She even beat Maki from the Hipsters! You
should have seen it! It was amazing, right, Haruka?

She gave me a real workout. If she hadn't been injured, I
don't know if I would have won.

Yeah, right, Haruka! You should have more confidence in
yourself, girl. You're a pro now, remember?
I guess you're right...

Well, let's eat. Hey, Yui! Your okonomiyaki is burning!
Yikes! It's starting to smoke!
What!? No way! Oh, my poor okonomiyaki! What do I do!?

(I can't even remember the last time I went out to eat with
friends. I feel so happy right now!)
Whew! I think I ate too much! But it was so yummy!
Your eyes are bigger than your stomach, Akari!
Hey, you ate more than I did!

I had so much fun today. I don't have many friends, and I'm
always working, so I never get a chance to do anything like
this.

That's why this day meant so much to me. Do you think, if
you two are ever free, we can maybe do this again sometime?
Haruka, are you hearing yourself right now?

Of course we can! As a matter of fact, we're dragging you
out again with us next time, like it or not! I mean, we're
friends, right?
Gosh, you two. Thank you so much.

Silly girl, getting all serious on us! Well, we have to go.
But remember! We'll be coming for you soon enough! See you
later!
Yeah, I'll email you, okay? Bye, Haruka-chan!
(It sure is nice to have real friends.)
I hope it came out well! Yui, is it done printing yet?
Not quite.
Okay, here it is!
Ooh, I like it!

I haven't taken a PrintCircle picture with friends in ages.
How about you, Haruka-chan?
Um... I don't think I ever have.
Wha⑬? Seriously?
Yup. I'll treasure this one forever.

All right, I'd better get home. Thanks for hanging out, you
two!
Yeah, that was a lot of fun! See you, Haruka-chan!
See you! Thanks, you two!

(A PrintCircle photo with my friends... Little things like
this are really special.)

(Let's see. This is the event hall where the Dance Battle
Summit is being held.)

(There isn't much time before the summit starts. What should
I do?)
(I'd better make sure I'm prepared for the summit.)

(I'd better go to the event hall. I wonder if Akari is there
yet?)
(This is the salon Yoko-san told me about.)
(Uh-oh. Yoko-san said I'd need 20,000 yen.)
(I'll have to come back when I have more money.)
(I've got the money, so let's give this a try.)
(Wait, it says a treatment's only 6,000 yen.)
(Why did Yoko-san tell me I'd need 20,000?)
Welcome. What can I do for you?
Oh, um, is the stylist who does Yoko-san's hair here?
Ah, that would be me.
Why are you so surprised?
Oh, no. It's nothing.
Yoko-san told me all about you. This way, please.
All done. That will be 20,000 yen, please.
Huh? But the sign said treatments are 6,000 yen.
Oh, didn't Yoko-san tell you? She wanted me to sell you this original shampoo and leave-in treatment. One bottle each.
Oh... All right then. I'll take those, too.
(So that's why Yoko-san said I'd need 20,000 yen. Still, 7,000 yen a bottle sounds really expensive for shampoo and treatment.)
(She didn't mention anything about this. I'll have to complain to her when I get back.)

(Getting email from friends sure cheers me up. I feel like I
can work even harder now!)

Sawamura-san! Today is a special edition of the show, so we'll be giving you questions of the more general variety.
Since you haven't lived in Sotenbori very long, now's a good chance to get more questions correct.
Very good. Let's get started.
With all ten questions correct, you win the title of "Trivia Fanatic" and 30,000 yen!
For meeting the seven-question goal, you win the title of "Trivia Buff" and 10,000 yen!
It looks like maybe you should start hitting the books.
Yes, I think you're right.
Sawamura-san! Today is another special edition of the show.
Which do you like better, questions about Sotenbori or questions about more general topics?
Oh, how could I choose? I like both!
Haha, I like them both, too. And I like your very kind answer.
Hehe. Why, thank you.
Fantastic job, Haruka-chan! You're a real pro at this! You managed to get not one, but multiple prizes!
I did my very best!
Well, folks! Now's your chance to write in and get yourself one of these prizes Haruka-chan poured her heart and soul into getting!
Everyone be sure to write in! Good luck!
Haruka-chan, thank you very much for coming today.
Tomorrow, we'll be welcoming a guest who's been getting attention for a certain psychedelic music video. You won't want to miss it!
Nicely done, Haruka-chan! You got a prize!
